One new AI model every 72 hours.

That is the pace the industry just set — and most enterprises are nowhere near ready for it.

BenchLM tracked 130 frontier AI model releases in the last 12 months. August 2026 broke the record with 22 launches in a single month. Alibaba led all labs with 13 releases, surpassing OpenAI at 12. And 45% of those models were open-weight — meaning real, deployable alternatives to closed APIs now exist for nearly half the frontier.

Here is what this means for business leaders: the model you selected last quarter may already be outclassed. Hard-coding to a single provider is no longer a technical decision — it is a strategic liability. The organizations gaining ground are the ones treating model selection as a continuous evaluation loop, not a one-time vendor choice.

The next competitive moat is not which model you use. It is how fast you can evaluate, swap, and redeploy when something better arrives.
